body:
Confirmed via a live server-to-server SIP digest-auth REGISTER probe against production Asterisk: auth succeeds, but registration fails with 404 -- messages.log shows "AOR '' not found for endpoint '1000'" (and '1000web'). The live deployed pjsip config files have drifted from the repo's own correct templates. Wrote sudo-queue/70-fix-asterisk-empty-aors.sh to patch and reload; not yet run. Commit 12ea086.

⚓ ☃
title: Root-caused SIP registration failure: live Asterisk config has empty aors= on endpoints 1000/1000web
